title: Abortion is the "Sacrament" of Satan - Marija Šošić [PODCAST Mreže Riječi #29]

reels.title: She went to get a referral for an abortion, and an infertile woman told her: give it to me
reels.hook: She went to get a referral for an abortion. Then she heard: give it to me
reels.why: The story has a clear premise and a powerful twist: a woman who has been unable to conceive for 10 years sits next to a girl going for an abortion. The figure 200 in the first seconds immediately carries the hook.
reels.speaker: Marija Šošić
reels.quote: Well don't do that, well give it to me.

cards.text: She went to get a referral for an abortion. Then she heard: give it to me
Marija Šošić, head of Centar za život Split
saved children's lives
Seasonal job on an island
The young man left her and said he would only stay with her if she had an abortion.
she was trying to conceive
Well don't do that, well give it to me.

reels.title: Conceived in rape, today a mother of seven children
reels.hook: Conceived in rape – today a mother of seven children
reels.why: The guest gives an answer to the most difficult situation with a clear argument and personal example. It ends with a rhetorical question that lingers in the mind.
reels.speaker: Marija Šošić
reels.quote: he receives only a few years in prison, and the child receives the death penalty who did nothing wrong.

cards.text: Conceived in rape – today a mother of seven children
Marija Šošić, head of Centar za život Split

children – and a sixfold grandmother

reels.title: Abortion scheduled for morning, while prayer warriors keep vigil all night
reels.hook: Abortion scheduled for tomorrow. Then a new message arrived
reels.why: The story has tension and a reversal: a message about giving up, night prayer, and a morning turnaround. Especially strong for an audience that believes in the power of prayer.
reels.speaker: Marija Šošić
reels.quote: Well here, I called the clinic, I will not do it.

cards.text: Abortion scheduled for tomorrow. Then a new message arrived
Marija Šošić, head of Centar za život Split
The young seasonal worker talked every day for a week with Centar za život.
every prayer warrior, all night – night watch

reels.title: Her parents rejected her, and then caught sight of the little belly
reels.hook: They rejected her. Then they caught sight of her little belly
reels.why: An emotional resolution with an image the viewer can picture: the parents break down when they see the grandchild on the way. It ends concretely – Angelo goes to second grade today.
reels.speaker: Marija Šošić
reels.quote: when they saw her like that with the small belly, they broke down, they realized that it was their grandchild.

cards.text: They rejected her. Then they caught sight of her little belly
Marija Šošić, head of Centar za život Split
When she became pregnant, her parents rejected her, so she lived in the house of the association Betlehem.
when they saw her like that with the small belly, they broke down, they realized that it was their grandchild.

reels.title: She thought she was worth nothing, and then she made a Rosary
reels.hook: They told her she was worth nothing. Then she made this
reels.why: A short and complete moment with a clear image: a woman cries over the first Rosary she made herself. Strong emotion in less than a minute.
reels.speaker: Marija Šošić
reels.quote: Well they taught me that I can't do anything, that I don't know anything, that I am not worth anything. And look, I created something with my hands

cards.text: They told her she was worth nothing. Then she made this
Marija Šošić, head of Centar za život Split
In the Split Centar za život, mothers make Rosaries with female volunteers.

reels.title: The father opposes abortion, and his signature is not even needed
reels.hook: The father opposes abortion. The law doesn't ask him anything
reels.why: A rarely heard perspective of fathers with a specific claim about the signature at the hospital. Sparks discussion in the comments.
reels.speaker: Marija Šošić
reels.quote: the father's signature is not needed at all, her signature is enough at the hospital and the father is actually not asked anything.

reels.title: Decades after abortion she still imagines the eyes of her child
reels.hook: Even after 20 years she wonders what kind of eyes it would have
reels.why: Begins with the powerful sentence „For us there is no going back anymore“ and carries the intimate, rarely spoken pain of women after abortion.
reels.speaker: Marija Šošić
reels.quote: I think about that child of mine, what he would be like, what kind of eyes that child would have

cards.text: Even after 20 years she wonders what kind of eyes it would have

reels.title: They offered her an apartment, utilities, and college, and she had an abortion anyway
reels.hook: They offer her an apartment, utilities, and college – and she has an abortion anyway
reels.why: A concrete offer of help right at the beginning, then an unexpected outcome and a strong claim at the end. Short and provocative.
reels.speaker: Marija Šošić
reels.quote: And look, there is not a single woman who is happy with having had an abortion.
